description: A tiny, cheerful season-spirit train conductor in a cute fantasy anime story. Friendly, playful and bouncy announcer voice, bright and clear with a sing-song lilt at the ends of announcements, youthful gender-neutral anime-style voice, smiling while speaking, medium pace. Can drop into a soft, warm, close whisper. Clean studio recording, no background noise.
